scope: Review runtime interior wall/floor/ceiling surfaces; no full interior artistic acceptance

wood.author: Daniel Andersson
wood.maps: Unmodified diffuse photograph only; scalar roughness 0.9, no fabricated PBR channels

plaster.source: Existing Quaternius city-core CC0 material family, provenance in its SOURCE.md
plaster.use: normal 0.45; ORM red=AO, green=roughness; physical mip levels

projection: World-aligned triplanar; plaster tile 2.86m, wood tile 2m; scale independent of structural box dimensions
remaining: Measured steady-world performance on weak hardware
quality: Live presets 0/1 retain diffuse textures and scalar roughness; presets 2/3 enable plaster normal/AO/roughness maps.
